title: Signal Primitive
description:
Implement a `signal(initial)` function that returns a reactive signal object with three methods:

- `get()` — returns the current value
- `set(value)` — updates the value and notifies all subscribers
- `subscribe(fn)` — registers a callback called on every future change; returns an unsubscribe function

**Example:**
```js
const count = signal(0);
const unsub = count.subscribe(v => console.log('count:', v));
count.set(1); // logs: count: 1
count.set(2); // logs: count: 2
unsub();
count.set(3); // no log
console.log(count.get()); // 3
```
ai_context: Common mistake: calling subscribers with the old value instead of the new one, or forgetting to return the unsubscribe function. Also, learners sometimes use an array and splice for unsubscribe — a Set with delete is cleaner and O(1).
